notes: Neural Lives: link one citizen, read their CityNet dossier, inspect employment, money, housing, weekly economy snapshots, and event history, then set a safe neural training plan across seven broad career tracks. Neural aptitudes, skill gains, costs, energy, weekly resolution, and training history persist through save schema 6 while the other 299 citizens continue autonomously. The release passed static contracts, Android runtime smoke, CityNet interaction smoke, visual checkpoints, signed export, and checksum verification.
